statement: Valve's public steam-devices rules grant a Valve hidraw access path to Bluetooth bus-number 5 HID nodes and an evdev access rule for the Valve vendor. Rules grant access but do not implement Steam client discovery, identification, controller-test UI, or actual Bluetooth pairing. steam-devices 60-steam-input.rules lines 7-14.

applicability.revision: host sources Linux v7.3, SDL e0232c5 and 531acc, BlueZ aa4f5ce; device firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer source evidence, not physical Bluetooth or virtual-host observation. Public Steam Linux integration is limited to the observed rules, not proprietary Steam client internals.
